data.title: Connect Coaching Data to an AI Agent, Safely
data.description: Give an AI agent access to clients, plans, habits and check-ins to draft weekly updates — bounded by guardrails, every write reviewed before a client sees it.
data.keywords: AI agent for coaches, MCP fitness integration, connect coaching data to AI, AI workout automation, AI training plan guardrails, agentic coaching tools

_rationale: Description was accurate but did not signal the safety/guardrails angle this cycle surfaced as the market gap; more technical searchers evaluating a data-access integration want to know the write path is bounded, not just "reviewed". Feature anchors: Guardrails on AI plan changes, Coach-in-the-loop review.
